name: designmd.sh
summary: Public registry of DESIGN.md design-system files that coding and design agents install with one command.
description: A community registry of DESIGN.md files: single markdown documents that record colors, typography, spacing, elevation and component behavior so an AI coding agent can build UI that matches a brand. Entries are browsed on a trending / most-installed leaderboard and installed with `npx designmd.sh add <owner/repo>`, which downloads the file from its source repository (the site does not host the files). The registry follows Google's DESIGN.md spec and runs each submission through spec validation, a prompt-injection scan and an AI review.
contains: 53 urls in the sitemap, 48 docs pages
leaderboard of trending and most-installed design files
each file checked by spec validation, prompt-injection scan and AI review
files downloaded from source repositories, not hosted on the site
works with Claude, Cursor, Gemini, ChatGPT, VS Code, GitHub Copilot, Lovable, v0, Bolt, Framer, Webflow
